# OpenOrbia

> OpenOrbia lists free and open-source AI tools for small businesses, job seekers and security teams. Each tool's free tier, card requirement, data location, setup, paid parts and biggest catch are checked by hand against its official docs, with the date shown.

- No ads. No paid placement. No affiliate links. A tool never pays to be listed.
- We check every tool's activity and license every month, and recheck the full Free facts at least every 3 months. Each card shows its last-checked date.
- "Not confirmed" means the official docs did not say; it is not a yes or a no.
- Our checks cover the license, pricing, setup and where your data goes, read from each tool's official docs. They are not a security audit: we don't review a tool's code or dependencies for vulnerabilities or malware. Before you run a tool, especially one that installs with a script, downloads programs or model files, or scans and attacks systems, review it yourself and try it somewhere isolated first.
- Tools are "Docs checked" unless marked "Hands-on tested", which OpenOrbia gives only to tools it has actually run.
- Each tool page is the source of truth for its facts: https://openorbia.com/tool/<slug>/. The short index is https://openorbia.com/llms.txt.

## Small businesses

### AnythingLLM

Chat with your business documents in an AI app. Desktop or server; works with local models.

- Page: https://openorbia.com/tool/anythingllm/
- Source code: https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm
- License: MIT
- Free tier: Free desktop app or self-hosted Docker (MIT); paid hosted option
- Card required: No
- Your data: Runs on your computer
- Setup: Desktop app
- Paid service: None
- The catch: Multi-user and embed widget need the Docker version; local AI needs decent hardware
- Helps you: Chat with your own documents and run AI agents on a private, local AI app
- Local AI: Works with local AI
- Facts checked against the docs: Nov 14, 2026
- Hands-on tested by OpenOrbia: No
- Official sources: https://github.com/Mintplex-Labs/anything-llm#readme, https://anythingllm.com, https://docs.anythingllm.com/installation-desktop/system-requirements

### Ollama

Run open AI models on your own computer or server.

- Page: https://openorbia.com/tool/ollama/
- Source code: https://github.com/ollama/ollama
- License: MIT
- Free tier: Free & unlimited for local models (MIT); paid cloud optional
- Card required: No
- Your data: Runs on your computer
- Setup: Desktop app
- Paid service: None
- The catch: Local models run on your own hardware; cloud models are billed per token on pay as you go
- Helps you: Run open AI models on your own computer and chat with them or use them in apps
- Local AI: Works with local AI
- Facts checked against the docs: Nov 14, 2026
- Hands-on tested by OpenOrbia: No
- Official sources: https://github.com/ollama/ollama#readme, https://ollama.com/pricing, https://docs.ollama.com/faq

### n8n

Automate business tasks with AI agents across 400+ apps.

- Page: https://openorbia.com/tool/n8n/
- Source code: https://github.com/n8n-io/n8n
- License: Sustainable Use
- Free tier: Free self-hosted Community Edition (fair-code license)
- Card required: No
- Your data: Your server
- Setup: Install & self-host
- Paid service: Optional: None needed; AI steps can use paid OpenAI/Anthropic keys or open-source models
- The catch: SSO, Git version control and Projects are not in the free Community Edition; they need a paid Business or Enterprise plan
- Helps you: Build automated workflows and AI agents that connect your apps
- Local AI: Works with local AI
- Facts checked against the docs: Nov 14, 2026
- Hands-on tested by OpenOrbia: No

### Open Notebook

Private, self-hosted NotebookLM alternative: chat with your documents, PDFs and web pages.

- Page: https://openorbia.com/tool/open-notebook/
- Source code: https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook
- License: MIT
- Free tier: Free & open source (MIT); you pay only for a cloud AI if you use one
- Card required: No
- Your data: Runs on your computer
- Setup: Install & self-host
- Paid service: Optional: None with free local models through Ollama; cloud providers such as OpenAI bill per use
- The catch: Needs Docker. No password by default: bind it to 127.0.0.1 or set one. Podcasts need a text-to-speech provider; Ollama has none
- Helps you: Chat with your own documents, PDFs and web pages and turn them into notes
- Local AI: Works with local AI
- Facts checked against the docs: Nov 19, 2026
- Hands-on tested by OpenOrbia: No
- Official sources: https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook#readme, https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook/blob/main/docs/0-START-HERE/quick-start-local.md, https://github.com/lfnovo/open-notebook/blob/main/docs/1-INSTALLATION/docker-compose.md

- Card required: No

- Helps you: Build AI agents and automated workflows visually and run them as an API
- Local AI: Works with local AI
- Facts checked against the docs: Nov 19, 2026
- Hands-on tested by OpenOrbia: No
- Official sources: https://github.com/langflow-ai/langflow#readme, https://docs.langflow.org/bundles-ollama, https://www.langflow.org/desktop

- Source code: https://github.com/Samyak9109/Abhyas
- License: MIT
- Free tier: Free (MIT); runs in your browser, data stays on your device
- Card required: No
- Your data: Runs on your computer
- Setup: Browser, ready to use
- Paid service: Optional: Free local model (text only) or your own Gemini/OpenAI key for voice
- The catch: Voice needs your own Gemini/OpenAI key; local models are text-only
- Helps you: Run voice mock interviews and get scored feedback on your answers
- Local AI: Works with local AI
- Facts checked against the docs: Nov 23, 2026
- Hands-on tested by OpenOrbia: No
- Official sources: https://github.com/Samyak9109/Abhyas#readme, https://github.com/Samyak9109/Abhyas/blob/main/LICENSE, https://abhyas.runs-on.dev/

## Security teams

### garak

- Free tier: Free command-line scanner (Apache-2.0)
- Card required: No
- Your data: Runs on your computer
- Setup: Install & self-host
- Paid service: Optional: Local Hugging Face model (free) or a paid API like OpenAI
- The catch: Needs a target model to test: a local Hugging Face model, or an API (OpenAI, Cohere, Groq and others) with your own key
- Helps you: Scan AI chatbots and language models for jailbreaks, leaks and other weaknesses
- Local AI: Works with local AI
- Facts checked against the docs: Nov 14, 2026

### Agentic Security

Scan your AI app or LLM endpoint with jailbreak and prompt-injection test datasets.

- Page: https://openorbia.com/tool/agentic-security/
- Source code: https://github.com/msoedov/agentic_security
- License: Apache-2.0
- Free tier: Free & open source (Apache 2.0); no SaaS, no account
- Card required: No
- Your data: Runs on your computer
- Setup: Install & self-host
- Paid service: Optional: None for the built-in mock or a local model; scanning a paid API bills per prompt
- The catch: Needs Python 3.15+. Scanning a paid API costs one call per prompt; test datasets download from Hugging Face
- Helps you: Scan your own AI app or model endpoint for jailbreaks and prompt injection
- Local AI: Works with local AI
- Facts checked against the docs: Nov 19, 2026
- Hands-on tested by OpenOrbia: No
- Official sources: https://github.com/msoedov/agentic_security#readme, https://github.com/msoedov/agentic_security/blob/main/docs/cli.md
